key_developments: Moonshot AI announced it will seek a Hong Kong IPO within the next six months.
The company’s ongoing funding round is set to lift its valuation above US$300 billion (≈HK$2,340 billion).
Its annual recurring revenue hit US$3 billion (≈HK$23.4 billion) in June, which management cites as a trigger for the listing.
The announcement comes as the Hang Seng Index fell 1.78% to 24,562.24 on July 17, underscoring market volatility.
Financial Secretary Paul Chan announced an optimized "Digital Transformation Support Pilot Scheme" to be launched within the year to help SMEs adopt AI solutions.

articles.title: 新股IPO丨月之暗面傳擬最快半年內來港上市
key_points: AI startup Moonshot AI (月之暗面) has informed investors of plans to list in Hong Kong as early as within 6 months.
The company is completing a funding round that would push its valuation beyond 300億美元 (approximately 2340億港元).
Annual recurring revenue reached 3億美元 (approximately 23.4億港元) as of June this year, which the company views as a signal that the timing for an IPO is mature.
articles.attention_reason: Potential high-profile AI IPO in Hong Kong.

articles.title: 陳茂波:香港銳意發展成AI研發轉化地
key_points: Financial Secretary Paul Chan announced an optimized 'Digital Transformation Support Pilot Scheme' to be launched within the year to help SMEs adopt AI solutions.
The Sha Ling Data Park is under construction and is projected to provide approximately 180,000 PFLOPS of computing power by 2032, which is 36 times the current total capacity of Hong Kong.
Hong Kong Investment Management allocated 56% of its project funding last year to hard tech, including AI and the development of the RISC-V open-source architecture ecosystem.

key_developments: DeepSeek is set to launch its V4 “Full Blood” models – Flash (priced at 0.28 USD per million output tokens, rising to 0.56 USD at peak) and Pro (0.87 USD normally, 1.74 USD at peak) – on July 20, with performance claimed to approach OpenAI’s GPT‑5.6 and Anthropic’s Opus 4.8.
IKEA China plans to divest eight idle mainland retail properties as part of a broader asset‑optimisation effort.

articles.title: AI丨DeepSeek V4「滿血版」將發布
key_points: DeepSeek is expected to release V4 "Full Blood" versions (Flash and Pro) as early as July 20, with performance reportedly approaching OpenAI's GPT-5.6 and Anthropic's Opus 4.8.
The company is introducing a "peak-valley pricing" model where DeepSeek V4 Pro output costs 0.87 USD per million tokens normally, increasing to 1.74 USD during peak times.
DeepSeek V4 Flash will be priced at 0.28 USD per million output tokens normally, rising to 0.56 USD during peak periods, with cache-hit input at 0.0028 USD.
While V4's coding capabilities are said to rival GPT-5.6 Sol, it is noted as likely underperforming compared to the recently released Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI, though at a lower price point.
articles.attention_reason: Significant AI product launch may impact tech sector sentiment.
